name: PS-HMM-IDM
alternateName: Product-State Hidden Markov Model with Intelligent Driver Model
description: Bayesian product-state hidden Markov model for within-driver heterogeneity in car-following. Response regimes are Intelligent Driver Model (IDM) response surfaces; traffic scenarios are distributions of speed, net gap, and relative speed; a joint Markov process links them. Inference uses MCMC with exact forward-filtering backward-sampling. Includes paper reproduction on the highD dataset and a CSV interface for custom car-following data.

referencePublication.name: Modeling Within-Driver Heterogeneity in Car-Following through Coupled Response-Scenario Dynamics
Markov Regime-Switching Intelligent Driver Model for Interpretable Car-Following Behavior
